description: This PHP class defines a Symfony validator for preventing self-XSS in source editing within Drupal's CKEditor5 module. It validates HTML restrictions and attribute permissions to prevent dangerous attribute usage.

classes.name: SourceEditingPreventSelfXssConstraintValidator
classes.description: A Symfony validator class for ensuring source editing does not allow self-XSS by validating HTML attribute restrictions.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input value against the self-XSS constraint, checking HTML restrictions and attribute permissions.

methods.name: isWildcardAttributeName
methods.description: Checks if an attribute name contains a wildcard character '*'.

methods.name: getRegExForWildCardAttributeName
methods.description: Generates a regex pattern to match wildcard attribute names.
